detail: The strategy drill, free play with counted grading, all three counting drills, the dealing-speed dial and the drawn tray are done. Every question and every verdict comes from the engine, so a drill in the browser is the same drill as in the terminal on the same seed.
doneWhen: A tally or a session can follow you between devices. It lives in `localStorage` today because per-player state on a service with no authentication would collide between two browsers on one network.
title: Local app: trainer, free play and the drills
